reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 19.2 gives a 90-day conformance warranty for Deliverables (and conformance for hosted Services throughout the subscription term), which meets the preferred/fallback period, and Section 19.4 supplies the full remedy ladder (re-performance, repair or replacement, then termination and refund of Fees paid), matching the model remedy language.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding — the clause is not over-flagged as a deviation.

The failed deterministic check ('warranty period ≥ 90 days') is a false negative caused by the period being spelled out in words ('For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later'); substantively the period requirement is satisfied.

Rationale statements about Sections 19.1, 19.3, 19.5 and 6.2 (workmanlike standard, malicious code, disclaimer carve-out, extra refund right) are not verifiable from the two supplied paragraphs, but they are additive and the cited material terms alone establish compliance, so this does not change the verdict.
